Commentary.Commentary: The chase is set to begin. Oman players stride out to the middle. Followed by Dinesh Chandimal and Pathum Nissanka who come out to bat for Sri Lanka. Kaleemullah to start with the ball.
... The Run Chase ...

Not a good day in the field for the Islanders. There were many opportunities that were not grabbed by both hands. Sri Lanka started strongly, they kept chipping wickets at regular intervals. But they could not stem the flow of runs. The spinners were taken to the cleaners especially, Akila Dhananjaya. Lahiru Kumara and Chamika Karunaratne picked up a brace each. While, Binura Fernando, Maheesh Theekshana and Dasun Shanaka took 1 wicket apiece. Now the onus lies on their batters to chase down the target of 160 runs to seal the series. Will they be able to do that? To find out, do join us for the chase on the other side.
Slower ball, on a length, outside off. Kaleemullah swings hard but he only manages a thick inside edge and the ball goes towards square leg. The batters cross for a run. Oman finish with 159/8.
Length ball, outside off. Fayyaz Ahmed drills it to long off for a single.

A good batting show put up by Oman! The batters were on the attack especially against the spinners. There was a period when it was raining sixes in Oman. Prajapati and Maqsood knocked a few boundaries but could not stick around for long. Then came a crucial stand between Aaqib Ilyas and Ayaan Khan who kept scoring runs at a good rate, although there were a little lucky with the dropped catches. But eventually, the former was sent back on 60 runs. After his departure, the batters could not find any inspiration and ended their innings at 159/8.

A good comeback by Sri Lanka in the death overs. They had lost the track in the middle overs and Oman did not hesitate to pounce on it. But in the end they fell short of the 170-run mark, which looked achievable at one stage.

OUT! CAUGHT! That is a really good catch from Avishka Fernando at long on! Length ball, on middle. Sandeep Goud looks to slog but he miscues it towards long on where Avishka Fernando takes the catch, he loses balance and loops the ball behind before going over the ropes. He comes back inside the ropes and completes the catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Avishka Fernando b Dasun Shanaka

Commentary.Commentary: Kaleemullah strides out!
Full ball, outside off. Sandeep Goud drives but finds the extra cover fielder.
Wide! Shanaka bangs it into the deck, outside off, and well over the batter. Sandeep Goud misses his pull. Wided!
Slower ball, shorter in length, outside off. Sandeep Goud slices it over cover for a couple of runs.
Leg bye! Full ball, angling in from middle and leg. Fayyaz Ahmed misses his slog and the ball hits him on the pads. The ball rolls away and they take a leg bye!
FOUR! A much-needed boundary for Oman, as it also brings up their 150! A full toss, outside off. Sandeep Goud cuts it over point and collects a boundary.
DOT BALL! Full ball, way outside off. Sandeep Goud moves across to drive but he misses.
Full ball, outside off. Fayyaz Ahmed drags it to long off for a single.

In the air, but safe yet again! Good-length ball, outside off. Sandeep Goud looks to cut hard but he gets a top edge and the ball lands just in front of the point fielder who tracks back to collect it. A single taken!
Another slower ball, outside off. Fayyaz Ahmed cuts it to backward point and takes a run.
Slower ball, outside off. Fayyaz Ahmed looks to heave it away but he fails to get any bat on it.
FOUR! Nicely done! Length ball, outside off. Sandeep Goud slices it past point for a boundary.

OUT! RUN OUT! Sri Lanka are roaring back into this game! Length ball, on off. Mohammad Nadeem pushes it to mid off and looks to take a run. Avishka Fernando there, gathers the ball cleanly and hits the stumps at the non-striker's end. Mohammad Nadeem is short of his crease and he has to walk back!
Fayyaz Ahmed arrives into the middle.
Who comes in? Mohammad Nadeem.
OUT! BOWLED! AND AGAIN! A yorker, around off. Ayaan Khan looks to dig it out but he is beaten all ends up and the ball crashes onto his off pole.
Excellent stop in the deep! Good-length ball, outside off. Sandeep Goud stays back and runs it down to the left of the third man fielder. The fielder runs there and keeps it to one.
OUT! BOWLED! You miss, I hit, says Kumara! Full ball, around off. Naseem Khushi looks to heave it away but he misses it completely and the ball crashes onto his stumps.
The next batter is in. It is Sandeep Goud.
Yorker-length ball, on middle. Ayaan Khan digs it out to the leg side for a single.
SIX! BANG! What a way to get off the mark! Slower ball, on a length, outside off. Naseem Khushi moves across and whacks it way over deep mid-wicket for a biggie!

OUT! TAKEN! Chamika Karunaratne gets his man this time and he is pumped! Back of the hand slower ball, on middle. Aqib Ilyas looks to clear long on but he gets the splice of the bat and the ball goes straight to Dasun Shanaka at long on who does not make any mistake!
Commentary.Howout: c Dasun Shanaka b Chamika Karunaratne

Commentary.Commentary: In the air, but short of the fielder. Length ball, on off. Ayaan Khan looks to reverse scoop but he mistimes to Maheesh Theekshana at short third man. A single taken.
Who comes in now? Naseem Khushi, it is.
Good-length ball, on middle. Aqib Ilyas drills it to long on for a run.

DROPPED! Full ball, outside off. Aqib Ilyas moves across to go over cover but he gets the toe end of the bat. The ball goes towards deep cover where Charith Asalanka runs forward to take the catch but he drops it. Two taken.
Bye! Slower ball, outside off. Ayaan Khan skips down to slog but he misses. The batters sneak in a bye!
SIX! Man, that is some shot! This is given a nice loop, fuller on middle and leg, Aqib Ilyas whips this one over the deep mid-wicket fielder for a biggie.
On middle, smacked down to long on for one.
On middle and leg, Ilyas works this to the leg side for a single.
Fifty for Aqib Ilyas! Solid knock from him so far. Full toss, outside off, Aqib Ilyas skips down and hammers this towards long on for a couple.
SIX! WHACK! Aqib Ilyas moves closer to his fifty! Loopy, around off, Aqib Ilyas clears his front leg and thumps this one massively over the bowler's head for a biggie.
Short, outside off, Khan looks to slice it away but gets the bottom edge towards short third man for one.
Banged in short, around off, hooked away to the leg side for one.
Back of a length, outside off, pulled to the deep mid-wicket region for one.
This is pulled again to the deep mid-wicket region and the batters are able to collect two runs.

A touch shortish, around off, Aqib Ilyas pulls this one towards the deep mid-wicket region. The man in the deep runs forward, reaches out, takes it, but he fell down due to the momentum and the ball falls out. Two.
Fuller outside off, the drive is missed.
Short on middle, pulled down to long on for a run.
Shortish outside off, Aqib looks to slash but misses.
Flatter, outside off again, the reverse-hit it lofted over point for a run.
WIDE. Spinning away outside off, left alone again.
WIDE. Way outside off, left alone.
Around off, defended.
Fuller, outside off, Khan lines up to play the reverse-sweep but misses his shot.
Outside off, angling in, Khan swings but misses.

DROPPED! Another one. Flatter, way outside off, Ayaan Khan skipped down the track and slammed this towards covers. It takes the toe end and lobs up. The man backtracks, gets the ball but it pops out. Two taken.
Maheesh Theekshana comes back into the attack.

FOUR! A boundary to end proceedings in this over! Aqib Ilyas is playing a good hand here! Short and wide outside off, Aqib Ilyas slaps this towards backward point. The fielder there gets his hand up and the ball hits his hands and bursts through to the ropes.
Short again, around off, pulled along the ground to deep mid-wicket for one.
Short, around off, AI taps this to backward point for a quick single.
FOUR! Well played. Short, angling down the leg side, Aqib Ilyas gets inside the line and powers this to the fine leg fence.
On middle, played towards mid-wicket for one.
Short of a length, around off, hit back towards Shanaka, who pushes it towards mid off for a quick run.
Dasun Shanaka comes into the attack now.
Loopy ball, outside off. Aqib Ilyas drills it to long off to collect a single.
Tossed up, on middle. Ayaan Khan hits it hard and the ball disturbs the stumps at the non-striker's end. The ball deflects to long on and the batters cross for a run.
Leg bye! A huge appeal for LBW but the umpire is not interested! Flatter ball, around middle and leg. Aqib Ilyas looks to play the switch hit but he misses and gets hit on his pads.
On a length, around middle. Aqib Ilyas prods and turns it to mid-wicket.
Floated, around middle. Ayaan Khan drills it to long on for a run.
Tossed up, around off. Aqib Ilyas lofts it to long off for a single.
Akila Dananjaya is back on now.
Good running! Length ball, strayed on the pads. Ayaan Khan tucks it to the leg side and collects another couple of runs.
Yorker-length delivery, on middle. Ayaan Khan flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Kumara bangs it into the deck, outside off. Ayaan Khan looks to cut it over the keeper but he misses.
Good-length ball, on middle. Ayaan Khan tucks it to wide of deep square leg for a couple.
Good-length ball, down leg. Ayaan Khan misses his flick and the ball kisses his pads before going to the keeper.
Length ball, on off. Ayaan Khan pushes it to cover.
In the air..but safe! Tossed up, on off. Ayaan Khan skips down to slog but he miscues it to the long on fielder, on the bounce. A single taken.
Nicely tossed up, outside off. Ayaan Khan pushes it to cover.
Floated, around off. Ayaan Khan prods to defend this one but he gets an inside edge onto his pad.
Flatter ball, outside off. Aqib Ilyas cuts it to deep cover to collect a single.
Tossed up, around off. Aqib Ilyas blocks it out.
Ayaan Khan walks out at number 5.

OUT! TAKEN! WHAT A CATCH! Tossed up, around off. Zeeshan Maqsood goes down on his knee and looks to sweep but he only manages a top edge and the ball loops up in the air behind square on the leg side. Binura Fernando runs to his right from short fine leg and puts in a dive to take a stunner!
Commentary.Howout: c Binura Fernando b Maheesh Theekshana

Commentary.Commentary: Maheesh Theekshana comes back into the attack.
FOUR! WHACKED! Width on offer, and Aqib Ilyas does not miss out! Full ball, outside off. Ilyas lofts it just over the diving cover fielder for a boundary. 14 runs off this over!
Back of a length, on leg. Zeeshan Maqsood tickles it behind square on the leg side for a run.
Slower ball, on a length, around middle. Aqib Ilyas tucks it to the leg side for a single.
Good-length ball, around off. Aqib Ilyas defends it to cover.
SIX! WOW! Banged into the deck, around off. Aqib Ilyas swivels and hooks it way over fine leg for a biggie!
Length ball, outside off. Aqib Ilyas carves it past covers for a couple of runs.
Chamika Karunaratne comes back into the attack now.
13 off this one! Around off, defended out.
SIX! This is even better! Loopy delivery, fuller outside off, Zeeshan Maqsood steps out and hits this well over the extra cover fence.
SIX! There's the biggie! Zeeshan Maqsood looks to attack! Fuller, around middle, Zeeshan Maqsood gets low and nails his slog-sweep over deep square leg.
Served fuller, outside off, Aqib slams this towards long off and rotates the strike.
Another dot! Tossed up on middle, this is worked to mid-wicket, who stops well.
On middle, played to mid off.
Akila Dananjaya comes into the attack now.
Flatter, around off, spinning in, Zeeshan Maqsood goes back and slaps this behind point for a couple.
Short, outside off, sliced away to the right of the short third man fielder, who half-stops it for one.
Floated on middle, defended back to the bowler.
Darted on middle, knocked to the mid-wicket region.
Outside off, played to short third man for one.
Fuller, outside off, Zeeshan Maqsood looks to have a poke but misses.
On middle, nudged through mid-wicket and a couple of runs are taken.

SIX! It looked like it would be caught but he hits it well enough for a biggie. On middle, on a length, heaved hard over square leg. The man in the deep is interested in taking this but the ball goes just past the ropes there.
Back of a length, on off, guided to point.
Zeeshan Maqsood comes out now.
Around off, kept out.

OUT! TAKEN! Kashyap Harishbhai Prajapati's innings comes to an end. Chamika Karunaratne does well to pouch this too and the second wicket falls in no time. On a length, around off, Kashyap Harishbhai Prajapati looks to whip this to the leg side but gets a leading edge high in the air to the off side. Chamika Karunaratne runs after it, judges it well and pouches this.
Short and outside off, left alone this time.
Dragged shorter and on middle, knocked down to long on for one.
On middle and leg, KHP looks to tuck but misses and gets hit on the pad. An appeal for LBW but turned down.
SIX! The second one of the over! Flighted outside off, Kashyap Harishbhai Prajapati gets low and slog-sweeps this one hard over square on the leg side.
Dot now! On middle, played to mid-wicket.
SIX! SHOT! Kashyap Harishbhai Prajapati gets hold of this one! This is tossed up, landing fuller around off, Kashyap Harishbhai Prajapati steps out and lofts this one effortlessly over long off.
A touch short, around off, pushed to covers.
Maheesh Theekshana comes to bowl.
Fuller and on off. Prajapti clips it to mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Nicely played. A full-length ball, on the pads. Prajapati flicks it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
A length ball, on off. Aqib Ilyas works it to mid on off the inner half. They take one.
On middle, tucked to mid-wicket for a single.
A sharp bouncer, on off. Prajapti leaves it alone. Wide called.
Good-length ball, outside off. The ball nips in off the pitch. Kashyap Harishbhai Prajapati looks to heave it away but misses.
A length ball, on off. Prajapati pushes it to cover.
Aqib Ilyas is the new man in.

OUT! BOWLED! Four and out! Binura Fernando has the last laugh here. A length ball, on the leg stump. Singh tries to be innovative. He moves across and looks to scoop it over the keeper's head, but he fails to get any bat on it. The ball goes through to come in contact with the leg stump. Binura Fernando draws the first blood.
FOUR! Nicely played. Singh gets the first boundary of the innings. A length ball, on off. Singh pulls it through mid-wicket and finds the boundary.
An appeal for LBW but turned down. Fernando fires in a yorker on leg. Singh looks to dig it out but misses. The umpire says it is going down leg.
On off, kept out solidly.
A length ball, on off. Prajapati looks to flick it away to the leg side. The ball takes the outside edge and goes to point. They take one.
Nice away movement this time! Fernando hurls a good-length ball, on off. The ball moves away off the pitch. Prajapti looks to defend it out but misses.
A length ball, on middle. Singh hangs back and defends it to mid on.
On a length, on the pads. Singh tucks it towards mid on.
Bangs in a short delivery, on off. Singh looks to cut it away but misses.
FOUR BYES! Misses everyone. A length ball, on off. Singh looks to heave it away but misses. The keeper misses the ball as well. The ball races away to the fence at third man.
On off, pushed to covers.
Nicely bowled! What a delivery. A length ball, outside off. The ball nips in a bit. Singh looks to defend it out but misses. The ball beats the outside edge.
A length ball, on off. Prajapti defends it to point.
A length ball, on middle. Prajapti flicks it through mid-wicket for a couple.
A length ball, on off. Prajapati looks to defend it out. The ball takes the inside edge and goes towards fine leg.
LEG BYE! Full and on the pads. Singh misses his flick. The ball rolls to the leg side off the pads. The batters collect a leg bye.
WIDE! Full-length, down leg. Singh leaves it alone. Wide called.
LEG BYE! A length ball, on the pads. Prajapati looks to flick it but misses. The ball clips the pads and rolls to the leg side. The batters collect a leg bye.
Oman and Singh are off the mark! A length ball, on the pads, Singh tucks it to mid-wicket for a single.

Oman (Playing XI) - Kashyap Harishbhai Prajapati, Jatinder Singh, Aqib Ilyas, Zeeshan Maqsood (C), Mohammad Nadeem, Ayaan Khan, Sandeep Goud, Naseem Khushi (WK), Kaleemullah, Fayyaz Ahmed, Bilal Khan.
The players have made their way out to the middle. Jatinder Singh and Kashyap Harishbhai Prajapati are the opening batters for Oman. Binura Fernando to start with the ball.

Sri Lanka (Playing XI) - Pathum Nissanka, Dinesh Chandimal (WK), Avishka Fernando, Bhanuka Rajapaksa, Charith Asalanka, Dasun Shanaka (C), Chamika Karunaratne, Maheesh Theekshana, Lahiru Kumara, Binura Fernando, Akila Dananjaya.
TOSS UPDATE - Sri Lanka have won the toss and they have elected to BOWL first.

Hello and a warm welcome to all! It is time for the second T20I between Oman and Sri Lanka. The Islanders did take a 1-nil lead, but they did get a taste of the UAE conditions. Their top-order collapsed and would hope that does not happen this time around. Oman, on the other hand, would be quite happy with their performance both with the bat and the ball. They would hope they can put up a solid effort even today. Will they be able to steal a victory? We shall find out soon. Stay tuned for toss and team updates.
... MATCH DAY ...
